scope: Refresh open-source ACIS reader/writer maturity and verify the DXF MESH vertex-coordinate contract, then update existing plan owners and the local parser regression.

method.kind: Primary vendor/project documentation, release pages, and issue/PR status review; local generated parser regression
limitations: ACadSharp corpus-size and payload-extraction statements in PR discussion were not independently rerun.
The ACadSharp 3.4.9 writer-loss report concerns private customer drawings and was not reproduced against v3.8.0.
Project documentation and issue/PR pages establish route/maturity claims only, not format conformance or semantic geometry.
The generated MESH malformed-input cases establish local parser rejection, not native producer acceptance or subdivision rendering.

evidence.observation: Autodesk identifies MESH group 10 as a vertex position and defines the general primary point as X group 10 followed by Y/Z groups 20/30. ezdxf documents 3-tuple vertices and emits all three components for each example vertex.
evidence.planUse: Require a complete tuple per declared MESH vertex; accept Y/Z ordering after X, reject duplicate components and incomplete tuples at vertex/face-list boundaries.

evidence.observation: The latest signed release page is v3.8.0; its history includes v3.6.51's ACIS payload reader and Prototype1b reader changes. PR #1154 describes replacing the earlier DWG payload extraction path. This is read-side structural evidence only.
evidence.planUse: Permit only release-pinned structural-read comparison. Do not infer writer, B-rep, or native-consumer support; exact runtime and per-owner association remain required.

evidence.observation: Writer PRs #1150 and #1240 remain outside the released baseline. In the Oct. 1 #1150 discussion, its author says schema refactor #1174 is already in and describes branch conflicts; the maintainer says the intended writer should recreate ACDS schema rather than copy raw storage. Issue #1195 remains a report about ACadSharp 3.4.9 private drawings, not a reproduced v3.8.0 result.
evidence.planUse: Treat prior #1174-open statements as historical snapshots; do not count #1150/#1240 as released behavior or a passing peer comparator. Evaluate only at the existing composed checkpoint against pinned commits and per-handle carrier/owner closure.

evidence.route: Independent ACIS geometry and native acceptance
evidence.observation: OCCT lists ACIS SAT/SAB exchange among commercial components; ezdxf's drawing backend is not an ACIS geometry kernel; FreeCAD's stock importer limitation is distinct from explicit-entity DXF support.
evidence.planUse: Do not relax the independent semantic or native Linux/Windows consumer gates.

evidence.observation: DRW_Mesh::parseCode now tracks X/Y/Z component presence in its existing state-specific pending field and rejects missing or duplicate components before publishing the MESH callback. Generated ASCII and Binary DXF controls cover missing Y, missing Z, and duplicate Y.

existingOwnersRefined: explicit MESH DXF parsing and malformed-input fast tests
S8/PAR-07 modeler carrier, owner closure, and optional peer comparison
external ACIS semantics and native FreeCAD qualification
planDelta.localImplementationSlice: Require complete, non-duplicated MESH XYZ tuples; generated ASCII/Binary malformed inputs must be rejected before addMesh callback publication.
